strategy.title: No plan: the hive-contract price is only asserted, not evidenced
strategy.why: The only opening (brokered almond-pollination hive contracts, Valley Apiaries quoted at $110 per hive) depends on growers paying $150 per hive, but that price is something a person said, not a sourced figure, and no buyer has agreed to it. With a $40 margin the target needs 50 hives sold at exactly that price; without an evidenced price the economics and the deal count are unknown.

alternatives.title: Test-sell hive contracts at $150
alternatives.why: Possible after the price is grounded, but the 20/200 pre-order rate is from site visitors, not almond growers, and pollination happens in February, so whether growers pay inside the 30-day window is also unproven.
